The execution failed because the cell fill color for H12 was modified to 'FFFFF2CC', which did not match the expected '00FFF2CC' or 'FFF2CC' in the test suite. This occurred despite instructions to preserve formatting. 

Specifically, the error message was: `AssertionError: H12 fill changed: FFFFF2CC`. 

When using openpyxl, ensure that you are not inadvertently re-applying or modifying styles (fills, fonts, borders) when writing formula values to cells H12, L31, H35, L47, and H50. The hex code 'FFFFF2CC' suggests an ARGB value where 'FF' (alpha) was prepended or the color object was reconstructed incorrectly. Ensure you only update the `.value` attribute of the cells.
